summary: The filing is a Form 6-K report from Oddity Tech Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reporting that its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders was held on July 29, 2026, and that all proposals in the proxy statement were approved by the requisite majority. The report does not disclose specific proposal details, vote counts, or any special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. This is a routine post-meeting disclosure filed to comply with SEC requirements for foreign private issuers and to incorporate results into its registration statements. No transaction terms or recommendations are provided, and no risk-arb or special-situation angle applies.
